memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Be careful to do everything I have said to you. Do not invoke the names of other gods; do not let them be heard on your lips." - Exodus 23:13 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God calls His people to be careful — watchful and intentional — about their obedience and their devotion. And specifically, He warns them to keep the names of other gods off their lips altogether. In a land surrounded by idol worship, God wanted His people wholly His, not casually flirting with the gods of their neighbours. Devotion to the true God was to be guarded, undivided, and pure.

Notice the word "careful." Faithfulness to God does not happen by accident or drift. Left unguarded, our hearts naturally wander toward other loves and other loyalties. That is why God calls for intentional watchfulness. We have to be deliberate about protecting our devotion, or the countless "gods" of our culture will quietly creep in and claim the affection that belongs to God alone.

For us today, the "other gods" may not have names carved in stone, but they call to us constantly — money, success, pleasure, image, control. God's command is not to let these things take the place in our hearts and mouths that belongs to Him. He is not asking for grudging religion but for the guarded, undivided love of a heart that treasures Him above all. What might you need to be more careful to keep off the throne of your heart today?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
Am I intentional and watchful about guarding my devotion to God?
What "other gods" might be quietly creeping into my heart's affections?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You alone deserve my whole heart. Make me careful and watchful to guard my devotion, keeping every rival god off the throne that belongs to You. Amen.
